title: Putting Money Back on a Healthy Options Card When Another Payer Has Paid
content:
The card may be used toward a dental, vision or hearing cost the member's other cover did not pay, and never toward a cost that cover has already met, so where another payer has since met a cost the card has already paid, the money is put back on the card rather than leaving the member out of pocket twice. This is the standing basis of the Supplemental Benefit Allowance Programmes for such a recovery on a Ridgecrest Healthy Options Card.

**What it governs.** The money put back onto the card against the card transaction it relates to, and the benefit period that money is placed in. The money returns to the allowance it was spent from, and the member can see the credit and the new balance on the card straight away.

**How the credit is booked.** The representative unlocks the agent tool `post_dispute_credit_634307a6` and calls it. One call books a single credit entry on that card's running record: the entry names the transaction it relates to, carries the credit as a settled amount, and is placed in the benefit period given. The spendable balance held on the programme is raised by the same amount.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | What it is | Form |
|---|---|---|
| `allowance_program_id` | the reference number of the allowance programme whose card is credited | Id class, as returned by a lookup of the member's allowance programmes |
| `customer_id` | the member reference number the programme belongs to | Id class, as returned by the member profile lookup |
| `source_ledger_entry_id` | the reference number of the single card transaction this credit relates to | Id class, as returned by a lookup of that card's own entries |
| `credit_amount` | the money put back onto the card | Fixed-format class, in USD to 2 decimal places, a positive figure; the direction is carried by the entry itself, so no minus sign is used, and an empty value is not accepted |
| `benefit_period` | the benefit period the credit is placed in | Fixed-format class, written as a benefit period as YYYY-Qn, for example 2026-Q2, with the quarter in upper case and no spaces |

**What comes back.** A single line of confirmation text. It carries the reference number of the credit entry created, the credited amount in USD to two decimal places, the benefit period the entry was placed in, and the spendable balance the programme stands at once the credit is on. A line carrying that reference number is what indicates the credit was booked.
